title: add encrypted ENI bootstrap flow and deterministic DNS mirror rollback hooks
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: Customers deploying Private control planes in strict environments asked for stronger network-level guarantees: (1) control-plane ENIs must be provisioned encrypted at boot and bound to predictable IP allocations so firewall rules and egress policies can be pre-provisioned, and (2) DNS mirroring used during control-plane upgrades must support a safe rollback path that avoids left-behind stub zones or split-horizon drift. This PR implements an encrypted ENI bootstrapping flow in the Terraform installer, adds a deterministic IP assignment mode for controlplane subnets, introduces a lightweight Helm chart hook to seed a DNS mirror with signed zone metadata, and wires an automated rollback hook that re-scopes stub zone records and removes ephemeral mirror records on failed upgrades. Scope: terraform/modules/network/controlplane/* - new encrypted_eni module and deterministic_ip submodule; helm/controlplane/templates/dns-mirror-hook.yaml - pre-upgrade job to snapshot signed-records and post-failure job to reconcile; installer/upgrade/rollback.sh - idempotent rollback logic and a dry-run verifier; docs/installer/networking.md - operational notes and migration steps; test/terraform/controlplane_integ.tf - added integration fixture for encrypted ENI with mock KMS. Design notes: ENI encryption leverages customer KMS keys passed through the private-installer values and uses an immutable tag pattern (redwood:eni:hash) to detect re-attachment vs replacement during upgrades. Deterministic IP mode exposes a small allocator that maps a CIDR chunk + index -> stable IP and records the mapping in a tfstate-backed lock file so re-applies are stable across operators. DNS mirror hook writes signed RRsets into a namespace-backed ConfigMap and uses TTL pinning to avoid cache stomping; the rollback job reverses TTL pinning and prunes records only when lock metadata indicates the mirror was created by this release. Backwards compatibility: existing installs remain unchanged unless operators enable encrypted_eni or deterministic_ip via the new installer variables. Testing: added unit tests for allocator, a Helm integration run in CI that exercises pre-upgrade snapshot and a staged rollback scenario. Risks & mitigations: key rotation - the module refuses to re-encrypt existing ENIs without an explicit force flag; network policy mismatch - included a preflight verifier that checks security group rules against expected controlplane rule set. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module and unit tests - [x] Helm hook and rollback job - [x] Installer orchestration script - [x] Docs and migration guide - [x] CI integration run Summary of changes, commits and tests below.

review_comments: Ethan Park: Left a few nits on variable naming and suggested extracting the KMS key validation to the preflight checks instead of the module. Please add a unit test for the allocator edge-case when the CIDR has an odd-sized range.
Maya Patel: Addressed the variable renames and moved KMS validation to scripts/preflight/checks.sh. Added allocator unit test and a guard for odd-sized CIDRs.
Leah Morgan: Approved after confirming Helm hook obeys helm.sh/hook-weight ordering and that rollback job tolerates API transient failures. Commented about adding metrics for rollback-run counts.

Carlos Ruiz: Noted a concern about state-lock expiry causing duplicate IP allocations during long operations. Recommended a lock TTL bump and detection to avoid overlapping allocations. Maya responded with a small retry backoff and a detection heuristic that refuses allocation if a recent allocation timestamp is present.
CI Bot: Initial pipeline failed on 'helm template' due to missing Chart.yaml dependency; fixed by adding Chart.yaml and re-running. Second run passed all integration gates.
Ops: Please add a migration note for customers with pre-existing ENIs — the module will not replace ENIs by default. Added to docs.
Leah Morgan: Post-merge request to follow up with a dashboard for rollback metrics (ENG-4821 follow-up).
release_notes: Introduce optional encrypted ENI bootstrapping for control plane, deterministic IP allocation mode, and safe DNS mirror/rollback hooks. Backwards compatible unless features enabled. Operators should read docs/installer/networking.md for migration steps.
notes_for_ops: Enable features by setting installer values: encrypted_eni.kms_key and deterministic_ip.enabled. Run installer preflight to verify SGs, KMS access, and CIDR suitability. Rolling back a failed upgrade should be invoked via installer/upgrade/rollback.sh --run, or CI will execute a dry-run on failures.
test_summary: Added allocator unit tests, terraform integration fixture, and a helm integration run. CI initially failed on helm lint due to a missing Chart.yaml dependency, rerun passed all checks. Post-merge nightly integ will run full e2e against a mock VPC.
operational_impact: Low for existing clusters; enabling deterministic_ip or encrypted_eni will introduce new resources and require KMS permissions. Rollback hook reduces risk of lingering DNS mirror records after failed upgrades.
followups: ENG-4821: add rollback metrics dashboard and alerting; ENG-4902: investigate providing automatic KMS key rotation helper; PM-121: add UI toggle to Console for deterministic IP mode.
